title: Hausdorff measure and lower integrals over Lipschitz images (parent steps 7b, 7d)
statement: Let m, P ∈ ℕ, G : ℝ^m → ℝ^P, D ⊆ ℝ^m and Λ ≥ 0 with G Λ-Lipschitz on D. Let H^m = μHE[m] on ℝ^P and L^m = volume on ℝ^m. Then (a) H^m(G(N)) ≤ Λ^m·L^m(N) for every N ⊆ D. (b) If D is measurable, then ∫⁻_{G(D)} H dH^m ≤ Λ^m·∫⁻_D H∘G dL^m for every measurable H : ℝ^P → [0, ∞].
lean_statement: ∀ (m P : ℕ) (G : Euclid m → Euclid P) (D : Set (Euclid m)) (Λ : NNReal), LipschitzOnWith Λ G D → (∀ N ⊆ D, μHE[m] (G '' N) ≤ (Λ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ m * volume N) ∧ (MeasurableSet D → ∀ H : Euclid P → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable H → ∫⁻ x in G '' D, H x ∂μHE[m] ≤ (Λ : ℝ≥0∞) ^ m * ∫⁻ a in D, H (G a))
